idea-plugin.name: EN 18031 / PSTI Device Config Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Line-by-line check of shipped device defaults against RED Art. 3(3)(d)(e)(f), EN 18031-1/-2/-3 and UK PSTI Schedule 1

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EN 18031 / PSTI Device Config Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/en18031-psti-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/en18031-psti-lint

action.text: EN 18031 / PSTI Device Config Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EN 18031 / PSTI Device Config Lint on the file in the editor
